mil3.3.1:0.3: The Question on the Root of Time
mil3.3.1:1.2: “Venerable Nagasena, what is the root of past time, what is the root of future time, what is the root of present time?”
mil3.3.1:1.3: “Ignorance, Great King, is the root of past time, of future time, and of present time.
mil3.3.1:1.4: Ignorance is a requirement for formations. Formations are a requirement for consciousness. Consciousness is a requirement for name and form. Name and form are requirements for the six sense fields. The six sense fields are requirements for contact. Contact is a requirement for feeling. Feeling is a requirement for craving. Craving is a requirement for clinging. Clinging is a requirement for being. Being is a requirement for birth. Birth is a requirement for aging and death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, sadness, and distress to come to be.
mil3.3.1:1.5: Not even the beginning of this entire mass of suffering is discerned.”
mil3.3.1:3.1: The Question on the Root of Time: First.
